name: Zalaszentgyörgy (Hungary)
description: Dark green field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zalaszentgyörgy: a crowned red shield with a horseman, with red mantling, above a yellow scroll inscribed ZALASZENTGYÖRGY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Zalaszentgyörgy arms with crown, mantling and scroll
